name: awesome-skills
description: Agent Skills by @kryptobaseddev, plus the plugins that wrap them. Skills install on their own by copy or symlink; a plugin is only needed where a skill cannot reach — slash commands, subagents, and hooks.

plugins.name: deluxui
plugins.description: UX engineering with a verdict, from the first comp to the release gate. Adds /ux (the router), /ux-comp, /ux-decide, /ux-phase, /ux-select, /ux-fonts, /ux-init, /ux-create, /ux-improve, /ux-critique, /ux-audit, /ux-harden, /ux-responsive, /ux-optimize, /ux-design, /ux-uplift, /ux-doctor, /ux-live, /ux-color, /ux-type, /ux-native, /ux-polish, /ux-bolder, /ux-quieter, /ux-distill, /ux-clarify, /ux-extract and /ux-onboard, an independent ux-reviewer subagent, a PostToolUse hook that checks every interface file as it is written, and a PreToolUse gate that refuses UI edits until somebody has approved a direction. Wraps the deluxui skill: a 233-rule contract, 243 detectors across static, browser, native, process and manual tiers, 32 named operations, thirteen craft references, generators for the palette, the type scale and the comps themselves, and a release gate where NOT_RUN is never a pass.
